summary: KE Holdings filed a Form 6-K containing two Hong Kong Exchange exhibits: a notice that the board will meet on November 16, 2026 to approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results and an earnings call, and the routine monthly return of equity movements for October 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; the only figures are unchanged authorized share capital across Class A and Class B WVR shares. This is an ordinary meeting and reporting notice, not a special situation; watch the November 16 results for any capital-return or corporate-action signal.
